# Atomeric

> Atomeric is an AI-native growth studio based in Kolkata, India.
> We build AI-powered revenue systems for ambitious brands through
> four service tracks: Strategy, Build, Grow, and Transform.

## What We Do

- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — getting brands cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI
- AI content strategy and digital marketing
- Website design and web development for startups and B2B brands
- Lead generation systems powered by AI
- Brand strategy and go-to-market planning

## Who We Serve

Indian startups, SaaS companies, D2C brands, and B2B businesses that want
to grow faster using AI-first strategies.
